items.title_cn: 血液灌流联合连续静脉-静脉血液滤过治疗高甘油三酯血症诱发的急性胰腺炎：按炎症反应严重程度分层的疗效异质性
items.title_en: Efficacy Heterogeneity of Hemoperfusion Plus Continuous Venovenous Hemofiltration for Hypertriglyceridemia‐Induced Acute Pancreatitis Stratified by Severity of Inflammatory Response
items.abstract_cn:
摘要

背景 本研究旨在探讨血液灌流（HP）联合连续性静脉-静脉血液滤过（CVVH）与单纯CVVH在降低高甘油三酯血症性急性胰腺炎（HTG-AP）患者重症急性胰腺炎（SAP）发生率方面的疗效异质性，并按炎症标志物C反应蛋白（CRP）进行分层分析。此外，我们评估了次要结局，包括实验室指标反应、疾病严重程度与器官功能、医疗资源利用及治疗相关指标，以描绘联合治疗更广泛的疗效特征及其与主要终点的关系。进一步地，我们试图确定基于CRP的联合治疗窗口。

方法 本单中心回顾性研究纳入204例患者，分为HP + CVVH组（n = 103）和CVVH组（n = 101）。采用多因素logistic回归评估两组间的总体疗效差异。使用限制性立方样条（RCS）分析治疗疗效与CRP水平之间的非线性关系，并确定基于CRP的治疗窗口。次要结局分析中，分类变量采用多因素logistic回归，定量变量采用广义线性模型。

结果 经多因素调整后，HP + CVVH组与CVVH组之间SAP发生率无显著差异（p > 0.05）。RCS分析揭示了治疗分组与CRP水平之间存在显著交互作用。SAP的条件比值比（HP + CVVH vs. CVVH）仅在特定CRP范围内显著低于1：主分析中为194.96–296.91 mg/L，倾向性评分调整后为200.77–285.81 mg/L（p < 0.05）。在次要结局方面，HP + CVVH与第3天CRP、降钙素原和甘油三酯水平显著降低、14天内无SIRS天数更多、腹腔内压峰值更低、ICU住院时间更短、CVVH次数更少、肠内营养启动更早以及血液净化相关费用更高相关（均p < 0.05）。在无器官衰竭天数、胰腺坏死发生率、住院时间、总住院费用、总吗啡当量剂量、碳青霉烯类药物使用或机械通气持续时间方面，未观察到显著差异（均p > 0.05）。

结论 HP + CVVH在预防SAP方面未显示出优于单纯CVVH的总体优势。然而，次要结局分析表明，其在炎症控制改善、全身炎症反应更快消退、腹腔内压降低以及若干资源相关和治疗相关指标的更好恢复方面具有可测量的生物学和临床过程获益。但这些获益并未转化为SAP的统一降低。HP + CVVH对硬终点的效应是有条件的、非线性的，且依赖于基线炎症负荷，显著获益仅限于特定的CRP治疗窗口。因此，次要终点的改善不应等同于硬终点获益，启动HP + CVVH的决策应根据炎症反应强度进行个体化制定。
items.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Background This study aimed to investigate the heterogeneity in the efficacy of hemoperfusion (HP) plus continuous venovenous hemofiltration (CVVH) versus CVVH alone in reducing the incidence of severe acute pancreatitis (SAP) among patients with hypertriglyceridemia‐induced acute pancreatitis (HTG‐AP), stratified by the inflammatory marker C‐reactive protein (CRP). In addition, we assessed secondary outcomes encompassing laboratory response, disease severity and organ function, healthcare resource utilization, and treatment‐related indicators, so as to delineate the broader efficacy profile of the combination therapy and its relationship with the primary endpoint. Furthermore, we sought to identify a CRP‐based therapeutic window for the combination therapy. Methods This single‐center retrospective study included 204 patients who were assigned to the HP + CVVH group ( n = 103) or the CVVH group ( n = 101). Multivariable logistic regression was used to assess the overall difference in efficacy between the two groups. Restricted cubic splines (RCS) were employed to analyze the nonlinear relationship between treatment efficacy and CRP levels and to identify a CRP‐based therapeutic window. Secondary outcomes were analyzed using multivariable logistic regression for categorical variables and generalized linear models for quantitative variables. Results After multivariable adjustment, the incidence of SAP did not differ significantly between the HP + CVVH and CVVH groups ( p > 0.05). RCS analysis revealed a significant interaction between treatment group and CRP levels. The conditional odds ratio for SAP (HP + CVVH vs. CVVH) was significantly below 1 only within a specific CRP range: 194.96–296.91 mg/L in the primary analysis and 200.77–285.81 mg/L after propensity score adjustment ( p < 0.05). Regarding secondary outcomes, HP + CVVH was associated with significantly lower CRP, procalcitonin, and triglyceride levels on day 3, more SIRS‐free days within 14 days, lower peak intra‐abdominal pressure, shorter ICU length of stay, fewer CVVH sessions, earlier initiation of enteral nutrition, and higher blood purification‐related costs (all p < 0.05). No significant differences were observed in organ failure‐free days, incidence of pancreatic necrosis, hospital length of stay, total hospitalization cost, total morphine equivalent dose, carbapenem use, or duration of mechanical ventilation (all p > 0.05). Conclusion HP + CVVH showed no overall superiority to CVVH alone in preventing SAP. Nevertheless, secondary outcome analyses demonstrated improved inflammatory control, faster resolution of systemic inflammatory response, reduced intra‐abdominal pressure, and better recovery in several resource‐related and treatment‐related indicators, indicating measurable biological and clinical process benefits. These benefits, however, did not translate into a uniform reduction in SAP. The effect of HP + CVVH on the hard endpoint was conditional, nonlinear, and dependent on baseline inflammatory burden, with significant benefit confined to a specific CRP therapeutic window. Therefore, improvements in secondary endpoints should not be equated with hard‐endpoint benefit, and the decision to initiate HP + CVVH should be individualized according to the intensity of the inflammatory response.
items.summary_cn: 该单中心回顾性研究显示，血液灌流联合CVVH与单用CVVH在降低高甘油三酯血症性急性胰腺炎患者重症急性胰腺炎发生率方面总体无显著差异，但联合治疗在特定CRP治疗窗（约195–297 mg/L）内可显著降低SAP风险，且与更好的炎症控制、更短ICU住院时间和更少CVVH次数等次要结局相关。

items.title_cn: 急性胰腺炎：实验室诊断与护理管理的综合方法——最新综述
items.title_en: Acute Pancreatitis: An Integrated Approach to Laboratory Diagnosis and Nursing Management-An Updated Review
items.abstract_cn: 背景：急性胰腺炎（AP）是一种炎症性疾病，病程多变，从自限性发作到伴有器官衰竭、局部并发症和死亡的严重疾病不等。早期识别和有效管理对于改善预后和减少长期胰腺损伤至关重要。目的：本综述旨在总结AP的诊断、病因、临床病程、住院管理、并发症以及预防复发性AP的策略。方法：本叙述性综述涵盖AP的主要方面，包括诊断标准、病因评估、严重程度分类、支持治疗和病因特异性干预。同时讨论胰腺坏死、急性骨筋膜室综合征、内分泌和外分泌功能障碍以及复发性疾病。结果：诊断基于以下三项特征中至少两项：特征性腹痛、血清淀粉酶或脂肪酶水平至少为正常上限的三倍，以及特征性影像学表现。胆结石和酒精是主要病因，而高甘油三酯血症、药物、操作及较少见的疾病也有致病作用。管理主要包括监测、静脉液体复苏、镇痛和早期口服或肠内营养。严重疾病可能需要多学科诊疗和针对感染性坏死的微创阶梯式治疗。长期并发症包括糖尿病和胰腺外分泌功能不全。复发预防取决于通过戒酒、戒烟、胆囊切除术、甘油三酯控制、药物审查和特定疾病的治疗来处理潜在病因。结论：准确诊断、基于严重程度的支持治疗、及时处理并发症和针对性预防是降低发病率、预防进展为慢性胰腺炎的核心，同时应支持长期随访和患者教育。
items.abstract_en: Background: Acute pancreatitis (AP) is an inflammatory disorder with a variable course, ranging from a self-limited episode to severe disease associated with organ failure, local complications, and death. Early recognition and effective management are essential to improve outcomes and reduce long-term pancreatic damage. Aim: This review aims to summarize the diagnosis, causes, clinical course, inpatient management, complications, and strategies for preventing recurrent AP. Methods: This narrative review addresses the main aspects of AP, including diagnostic criteria, etiological assessment, severity classification, supportive treatment, and cause-specific interventions. It also discusses pancreatic necrosis, acute compartment syndrome, endocrine and exocrine dysfunction, and recurrent disease. Results: Diagnosis is based on at least two of three features: characteristic abdominal pain, serum amylase or lipase levels at least three times the upper limit of normal, and characteristic imaging findings. Gallstones and alcohol are major causes, while hypertriglyceridemia, medications, procedures, and less common conditions also contribute. Management primarily involves monitoring, intravenous fluid resuscitation, analgesia, and early oral or enteral nutrition. Severe disease may require multidisciplinary care and a minimally invasive step-up approach for infected necrosis. Long-term complications include diabetes mellitus and pancreatic exocrine insufficiency. Recurrence prevention depends on addressing the underlying cause through alcohol abstinence, smoking cessation, cholecystectomy, triglyceride control, medication review, and treatment of specific disorders. Conclusion: Accurate diagnosis, severity-based supportive care, timely management of complications, and targeted prevention are central to reducing morbidity and preventing progression to chronic pancreatitis, while supporting long-term follow-up and patient education.
items.journal: Saudi Journal of Medicine and Public Health
items.summary_cn: 该综述总结了急性胰腺炎的诊断标准（腹痛、淀粉酶/脂肪酶升高≥3倍正常上限、特征性影像三者中满足两项）、病因评估、严重程度分级及以监测、静脉液体复苏、镇痛和早期肠内营养为主的治疗，并指出重症感染性坏死可采用微创阶梯式升阶梯治疗，长期并发症包括糖尿病和胰腺外分泌功能不全，复发预防需针对病因（戒酒、戒烟、胆囊切除、控制甘油三酯等）。

items.title_cn: 支持所提交稿件的源数据：布拉氏酵母菌衍生肌苷通过A2AR-CREB轴减轻急性胰腺炎
items.title_en: Source data supporting the submitted manuscript: Saccharomyces boulardii-derived inosine attenuates acute pancreatitis through the A2AR-CREB axis
items.abstract_cn: 本数据集包含支持手稿《布拉氏酵母菌来源的肌苷通过A2AR-CREB轴减轻急性胰腺炎》的数值源数据和显微镜图像导出文件。该研究探讨了布拉氏酵母菌和肌苷在实验性急性胰腺炎中的作用，并包含补充性临床细胞因子检测。该记录包含九个独立的ZIP压缩包。Supplementary_Data_1_Numerical_Data.zip包含74个数据CSV文件、一个重现较小数值表格的Excel工作簿，以及一个Contents.csv索引和README.txt。这些文件包括计算得出的检测浓度、组织学评分、荧光定量、相对基因表达测量值、经处理的RNA-seq分析结果以及培养上清液代谢组学差异分析结果。临床细胞因子文件对应手稿的图8A（IL-6）、图8B（IL-8）和图8D（TNF-alpha）；它们包含编码的参与者标识符、治疗分组以及基线/治疗后测量列。Supplementary Data 2-5均以Part1和Part2 ZIP文件形式提供。这八个图像压缩包共包含86个TIFF显微镜导出文件。每个ZIP可独立打开，并包含各自的Contents.csv和README.txt。这些索引提供了确切的图面板、检测项目和实验分组映射关系；补充数据压缩包编号与手稿图号并非一一对应。图像文件名和元数据标签已标准化为英文，来源和处理细节记录在README文件中。记录元数据和DOI是公开的。文件访问仅限于保密的编辑和同行评审评估。访问和重用受附于该记录的权利声明管辖。手稿确定匡茂斌、郑攀、李乐妍和魏冠月为共同第一作者，朱银和何聪为通讯作者。
items.abstract_en: This collection contains numerical source data and microscopy image exports supporting the manuscript "Saccharomyces boulardii-derived inosine attenuates acute pancreatitis through the A2AR-CREB axis". The study investigates Saccharomyces boulardii and inosine in experimental acute pancreatitis and includes complementary clinical cytokine measurements. The record comprises nine independent ZIP archives. Supplementary_Data_1_Numerical_Data.zip contains 74 data CSV files, an Excel workbook reproducing the smaller numerical tables, and a Contents.csv index and README.txt. These files include calculated assay concentrations, histology scores, fluorescence quantification, relative gene-expression measurements, processed RNA-seq analysis results, and culture-supernatant metabolomics differential-analysis results. The clinical cytokine files correspond to Figure 8A (IL-6), Figure 8B (IL-8), and Figure 8D (TNF-alpha) of the manuscript; they contain coded participant identifiers, treatment groups, and baseline/post-treatment measurement columns. Supplementary Data 2-5 are each supplied as Part1 and Part2 ZIP files. These eight image archives contain 86 TIFF microscopy exports in total. Each ZIP can be opened independently and includes its own Contents.csv and README.txt. These indexes provide the exact figure-panel, assay, and experimental-group mappings; the supplementary-data archive numbers do not correspond one-to-one to manuscript figure numbers. Image filenames and metadata labels were standardized to English, with provenance and processing details documented in the README files. The record metadata and DOI are public. File access is restricted to confidential editorial and peer-review assessment. Access and reuse are governed by the rights statement attached to the record. The manuscript identifies Maobin Kuang, Pan Zheng, Leyan Li, and Guanyue Wei as joint first authors, and Yin Zhu and Cong He as corresponding authors.
items.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
items.summary_cn: 该研究探讨了布拉氏酵母菌及其衍生的肌苷在实验性急性胰腺炎中的作用，并包含补充性临床细胞因子检测数据；数据记录涵盖数值数据（如组织学评分、荧光定量、基因表达、RNA-seq分析、代谢组学差异分析）及显微图像导出，临床细胞因子文件对应IL-6、IL-8和TNF-alpha。

items.title_cn: 早期计算血清渗透压与重症急性胰腺炎成人患者七天内肾脏替代治疗的分析代码及汇总输出
items.title_en: Analysis code and aggregate outputs for Early calculated serum osmolality and kidney replacement therapy within seven days in critically ill adults with acute pancreatitis
items.abstract_cn: 该存档包含分析代码、数据字典、汇总统计输出以及图表生成脚本，用于一项基于MIMIC-IV 3.1版和eICU-CRD 2.0版的回顾性研究，该研究探讨重症急性胰腺炎成人患者早期计算血清渗透压与七天内肾脏替代治疗的关系。存档还包括修订敏感性分析以及为正文和补充图重建的绘图脚本。不包含患者级数据。复现患者级分析需要获得源数据库的授权访问。随附文档中提供了操作说明和软件要求。
items.abstract_en: This archive contains analysis code, data dictionaries, aggregate statistical outputs, and figure-generation scripts for a retrospective study of early calculated serum osmolality and kidney replacement therapy within seven days in critically ill adults with acute pancreatitis using MIMIC-IV version 3.1 and eICU-CRD version 2.0. It includes revision sensitivity analyses and reconstructed plotting scripts for the manuscript and supplementary figures. Patient-level data are not included. Reproduction of patient-level analyses requires authorized access to the source databases. Instructions and software requirements are provided in the accompanying documentation.
items.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
items.summary_cn: 该论文提供了一项回顾性研究的分析代码、数据字典、汇总统计输出和绘图脚本，研究内容是重症急性胰腺炎成人患者早期计算血清渗透压与7天内肾脏替代治疗的关系，数据来源于MIMIC-IV 3.1和eICU-CRD 2.0，并包含修订版敏感性分析；患者个体数据未包含在内。

items.title_cn: 用于超快生物粘附和黏膜下注射的水凝胶
items.title_en: Hydrogels for ultrafast bio-adhesion and submucosal injection
items.abstract_en: Bio-adhesive hydrogels and lifting gels comprising sodium alginate and their use for preventing or controlling a gastrointestinal bleed or hemorrhage or sealing a perforation in tissue of a GI tract and separating diseased tissue from normal tissue in the GI tract, respectively, are disclosed. The hydrogel forms a calcium alginate barrier at the bleeding site, addressing the limitations of current endoscopic treatments for gastrointestinal bleeding which have limited efficacy, high recurrence of bleeding, and obscuration of the endoscopy view.
items.abstract_cn: 本发明公开了包含海藻酸钠的生物粘附水凝胶和抬举凝胶，分别用于预防或控制胃肠道出血或止血、封闭胃肠道组织穿孔，以及将病变组织与正常组织分离。该水凝胶在出血部位形成海藻酸钙屏障，解决了当前胃肠道出血内镜治疗疗效有限、再出血率高、以及内镜视野被血液遮挡的问题。同时可作为黏膜下注射抬举凝胶用于ESD术中组织分离。
items.summary_cn: 该专利由约翰斯·霍普金斯大学研发，提出一种基于海藻酸钠和CaCl₂的生物粘附水凝胶，在内镜下喷洒至出血部位后迅速形成海藻酸钙屏障实现止血。其核心创新在于兼具止血和黏膜下抬举双重功能：既能控制急性出血和迟发性出血，又能在ESD术中作为抬举凝胶分离病变组织与正常组织。优势在于减少多种内镜配件的使用需求，缩短操作时间，适用于难以精确定位的弥漫性出血和肿瘤出血场景。
items.assignee: JOHNS HOPKINS UNIVERSITY（美国约翰斯·霍普金斯大学）

items.title_cn: 用于机器人辅助手术的内镜多装夹施夹器
items.title_en: Endoscopic clip applier for robotic-assisted surgery
items.abstract_en: An endoscopic multi-load clip applier device includes a housing structured to include a compartment operable to store and distribute one or more clips; a flexible end coupled to the housing; and at least two grip components coupled to the housing and operable to compress and release upon control by robotic forceps of a robotic-assisted surgery system. The device enables multiple clip storage and automatic reloading, enhancing surgical efficiency and surgeon control in robotic-assisted surgery. The instrument can be introduced into an operative field via a bedside assistant port, and the surgeon can pick up the device using robotic forceps to place clips at the surgical site.
items.abstract_cn: 一���内镜多装夹施夹器装置，包括可存储和分发多个钛夹的壳体、连接于壳体的柔性端部、以及至少两个夹持组件。夹持组件可由机器人辅助手术系统的机械钳控制压缩和释放，使术者可在术中多次放置钛夹。该装置支持多夹存储和自动重装，提升机器人辅助手术中的效率和术者操控性。器械可通过床旁助手端口引入手术区域，术者使用机械钳夹取器械端部并在手术部位放置钛夹。
items.summary_cn: 该专利由加州大学研发，针对机器人辅助手术中血管结扎的痛点，设计了一种可存储多个钛夹并自动重装的内镜施夹器。核心创新在于将柔性端部设计与机器人机械钳操控相结合，术者可在不更换器械的情况下连续放置多个止血夹，大幅提升手术效率。该装置为一次性使用，成本低于现有技术，适用于机器人辅助的消化道手术中血管处理。
items.assignee: UNIVERSITY OF CALIFORNIA（美国加州大学）
